budget_items.topic: FY22 COA budget for Finance Committee
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Doherty said the COA would not increase the amount of money requested except for raises in salaries, ahead of the 2/18/2021 Finance Committee meeting.
budget_items.quote: the coa would not be increasing the amount of money requested except for raises in salaries.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager allowed Ms. Doherty to reallocate budget funds meant for paying instructors for cancelled in-person courses to pandemic-friendly events; no amount was printed.
budget_items.quote: allowed her to reallocate budget funds from paying instructors

budget_items.topic: FY22 formula grant funding per elder
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Doherty reported a projection that the state formula grant per elder would fall from $12 to $9, and said the total could still rise if based on the 2020 census.
budget_items.quote: grant funds will be reduced to $9 per elder from $12.

transfers.description: Reallocation of budget funds from instructor pay for formerly scheduled in-person courses to pandemic-friendly events (drive-thrus, Zoom meetings, banquet chairs), approved by the Town Manager.

transfers.quote: allowed her to reallocate budget funds from paying instructors
